scope: Finite expanded successful-SQL matrix for the unchanged 19-feature SQLite configuration. Native typed observations are the oracle; these statements do not supply predicted results or complete API/provider acceptance.

cases.name: json-mutation-types-and-trees
statements: SELECT json_insert('{"a":1}', '$.a', 9, '$.b', 2) AS inserted,json_replace('{"a":1}', '$.a', 7, '$.missing', 8) AS replaced
SELECT json_set('{"a":[1,2]}', '$.a[#]', 3, '$.label', 'x') AS appended
SELECT json_remove('{"a":[1,2,3],"b":9}', '$.a[1]', '$.b') AS removed
SELECT json_patch('{"a":1,"nested":{"x":2,"y":3}}', '{"a":null,"nested":{"x":4}}') AS patched
SELECT json_type('{"n":null,"b":false,"s":"x"}', '$.n') AS nullType,json_type('{"n":null}', '$.missing') AS missingType,json_extract('{"n":null}', '$.n') AS sqlNull
SELECT '{"n":7,"s":"x"}' -> '$.s' AS jsonText,'{"n":7,"s":"x"}' ->> '$.s' AS scalarText,'{"n":7}' ->> '$.n' AS scalarInteger
SELECT key,type,value,atom,typeof(atom) AS atomStorage FROM json_each('{"a":[1,2],"b":null,"c":false,"d":"x"}') ORDER BY key
SELECT fullkey,path,key,type,atom FROM json_tree('{"a":[1,{"b":true}],"n":null,"s":"value"}') WHERE type NOT IN ('object','array') ORDER BY fullkey
SELECT json_valid('{broken') AS invalidText,json_valid('{"a":}') AS invalidValue,json_valid('{"a":1}') AS validText
SELECT json_valid('{x:1}',2) AS json5,json_valid('{x:1}',1) AS strictJson,json_valid(x'ff',8) AS invalidBinary

UPDATE search3 SET content='running fast' WHERE docid=2
SELECT docid,content FROM search3 WHERE search3 MATCH 'run' ORDER BY docid
DELETE FROM search3 WHERE docid=1

cases.name: rtree-update-delete-and-intersection
statements: CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE bounds USING rtree(id,minx,maxx,miny,maxy)
SELECT id FROM bounds WHERE minx<=3 AND maxx>=1 AND miny<=3 AND maxy>=1 ORDER BY id
UPDATE bounds SET minx=10,maxx=12,miny=10,maxy=12 WHERE id=2

cases.name: geopoly-update-delete-and-spatial-predicates

cases.name: inspection-deterministic-invariants
statements: PRAGMA page_size=4096
CREATE TABLE inspected(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,v TEXT)

SELECT pgno,length(data)=4096 AS fixedPageSize,hex(substr(data,1,16)) AS formatHeader FROM sqlite_dbpage WHERE pgno=1
SELECT count(*)>0 AS hasStatements,min(ncol)>=0 AS nonnegativeColumns,min(ro)>=0 AND max(ro)<=1 AS booleanReadonly,min(busy)>=0 AND max(busy)<=1 AS booleanBusy FROM sqlite_stmt
SELECT count(*)>0 AS hasBytecode,min(addr)>=0 AS nonnegativeOffsets FROM bytecode('SELECT 40+2')
SELECT count(*)>0 AS hasVariable FROM bytecode('SELECT ?1') WHERE opcode='Variable'

cases.name: stat4-histogram-invariants-and-results
statements: CREATE TABLE histogram(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,k INTEGER,payload TEXT)
WITH RECURSIVE numbers(v) AS (VALUES(1) UNION ALL SELECT v+1 FROM numbers WHERE v<128) INSERT INTO histogram SELECT v,v%7,printf('row-%03d',v) FROM numbers
CREATE INDEX histogram_k ON histogram(k,id)
ANALYZE

SELECT count(*)>0 AS hasSamples,count(*)<=64 AS boundedSamples,min(length(sample))>0 AS nonemptySamples,min(typeof(sample)='blob') AS binarySamples FROM sqlite_stat4 WHERE tbl='histogram' AND idx='histogram_k'

SELECT min(CAST(neq AS INTEGER))>0 AS positiveEqualCounts,min(CAST(nlt AS INTEGER))>=0 AS nonnegativeLessCounts,min(CAST(ndlt AS INTEGER))>=0 AS nonnegativeDistinctCounts,max(CAST(nlt AS INTEGER))<(SELECT count(*) FROM histogram) AS boundedLessCounts FROM sqlite_stat4 WHERE tbl='histogram' AND idx='histogram_k'
SELECT tbl,idx,CAST(stat AS INTEGER)=(SELECT count(*) FROM histogram) AS accurateRowEstimate FROM sqlite_stat1 WHERE tbl='histogram' ORDER BY idx
SELECT k,count(*) AS rows,sum(id) AS sumIds FROM histogram GROUP BY k ORDER BY k
SELECT id,payload FROM histogram WHERE k=3 ORDER BY id LIMIT 5

cases.name: constraints-savepoints-and-successful-recovery
statements: PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON
CREATE TABLE parent(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,name TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,n INTEGER CHECK(n>=0))
CREATE TABLE child(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,parent_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES parent(id) ON DELETE CASCADE)
CREATE TABLE audit(parent_id INTEGER,old_n INTEGER,new_n INTEGER)
CREATE TRIGGER record_parent_update AFTER UPDATE OF n ON parent BEGIN INSERT INTO audit VALUES(old.id,old.n,new.n); END
INSERT INTO parent VALUES(1,'alpha',10),(2,'beta',20)
INSERT INTO child VALUES(1,1)
INSERT OR IGNORE INTO parent VALUES(1,'ignored',99)
SELECT changes() AS ignoredPrimaryKey
INSERT OR IGNORE INTO parent VALUES(3,'gamma',-1)
SELECT changes() AS ignoredCheck
BEGIN
SAVEPOINT outer_case
UPDATE parent SET n=n+5 WHERE id=1
SAVEPOINT inner_case
DELETE FROM parent WHERE id=1
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM parent) AS parents,(SELECT count(*) FROM child) AS children,(SELECT count(*) FROM audit) AS auditRows
ROLLBACK TO inner_case
RELEASE inner_case
SELECT id,name,n FROM parent ORDER BY id
ROLLBACK TO outer_case
RELEASE outer_case
COMMIT
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM child) AS children,(SELECT count(*) FROM audit) AS auditRows
INSERT INTO parent(id,name,n) VALUES(3,'alpha',99) ON CONFLICT(name) DO UPDATE SET n=excluded.n
INSERT OR REPLACE INTO child VALUES(1,2)
SELECT id,name,n FROM parent ORDER BY id
SELECT id,parent_id FROM child ORDER BY id
SAVEPOINT recovery
INSERT INTO parent VALUES(3,'gamma',30)
ROLLBACK TO recovery
RELEASE recovery
INSERT INTO parent VALUES(3,'gamma',30)
SELECT id,name,n FROM parent ORDER BY id
SELECT parent_id,old_n,new_n FROM audit ORDER BY parent_id,old_n,new_n
PRAGMA foreign_key_check
PRAGMA integrity_check
